name: simengine-mcp

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Run a Monte Carlo simulation. Provide either a domain filename (from the domains/ directory) or an inline config JSON. Returns statistics, safety results, fitness score, and a narrative summary.

config.description: Inline domain config JSON (alternative to domain filename)

overrides.description: Dot-path overrides applied to the config, e.g. {'parameters.close_rate.params.mode': 0.35}

n_simulations.description: Number of simulations to run (default: from config)

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all available domain configuration files in the SimEngine domains/ directory.

tools.name: validate_config
tools.description: Validate a domain configuration JSON. Returns whether it is valid and any errors found.

config.description: The domain config JSON to validate

tools.name: optimize
tools.description: Run evolutionary optimization on a domain to find the best control settings. Uses a genetic algorithm with safety constraints.

tools.name: update_bayesian
tools.description: Bayesian-update simulation parameters using real observed data. Uses conjugate prior updates (Beta-Binomial, Gamma-Poisson, Normal-Normal) to calibrate the model.

observations.description: Map of variable_name to array of observed values, e.g. {'close_rate': [0.25, 0.30, 0.28]}

tools.name: convergence_check
tools.description: Run convergence diagnostics to verify that the simulation sample size is sufficient. Tests whether statistics stabilize as N increases.

metric.description: Target metric to check (default: first metric)

tools.name: sensitivity_analysis
tools.description: Run one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis to rank which input parameters drive the most output variance. Returns elasticity and relative importance scores.

metric.description: Target metric to analyze (default: first metric)

tools.name: baseline_comparison
tools.description: Compare Monte Carlo simulation results to a deterministic (spreadsheet-style) single-point forecast. Shows the risk information hidden by deterministic forecasting.

tools.name: decide_under_uncertainty
tools.description: Decision gate for agents. Runs a Monte Carlo simulation and returns whether to PROCEED or ESCALATE based on how much of the OUTCOME distribution falls inside an acceptable range you specify. Returns the full outcome distribution plus a proceed/escalate flag and a plain-English reason. Use this to stop a multi-step agent from acting on an overconfident point estimate. NOTE: this models OUTCOME RISK (the spread of results given uncertain inputs) — not the language model's own token confidence.

config.description: Inline domain config JSON (alternative to domain filename)

metric.description: The output metric to evaluate the decision against

acceptable.description: Acceptable range for the metric; provide at least one of 'min' or 'max'.

min.description: Lowest acceptable value (omit for no lower bound)

max.description: Highest acceptable value (omit for no upper bound)

min_confidence.description: Probability mass that must fall within the acceptable range to proceed (default: 0.8)

n_simulations.description: Number of simulations to run (default: from config)
